title: Warm Coffee from Beginning to End
text:
Warm Coffee from Beginning to End. Thermal carafe coffee makers are nice for those who like a nice, warm cup of coffee and want to save electric power. These coffee makers do not heat continuously- the metal carafe receives the hot liquid and attempts to keep it insulated and warm, from the first cup to the final drink.

I have owned two different thermal carafe- style coffee makers and have found them useful, but not perfect. This Frigidaire model is the second one I have owned and it is about as good as my Cuisinart, which means it is good, but does have some issues. The greatest issue is that it doesn’t brew very quickly and this is particularly true when you dial the strength up to high, which you will want to do because the other settings produce coffee that is too weak. In this full strength setting, you have to wait and wait for the unit to complete the brewing cycle. I haven’t timed it, but I am sure it is over 10 minutes for a full pot. This is much too long and impractical when you’re in a hurry. You are forced to brew a smaller pot when time is tight.

Cleaning/drying is another issue. This is the same problem I had with my other thermal carafe. The way it is shaped, you have a very difficult time reaching inside, under the rim, to dry after washing. If you have VERY tiny hands, it might work but even then, it will be a challenge.

Some people will not like the fact that this coffee maker isn’t capable of brewing a really HOT cup of coffee. It is true- the coffee is not as hot as the coffee produced from an ordinary coffee maker. But I don’t mind this. Warm is generally good enough for me and we tend to empty the pot in my household quickly enough that the coffee remains warm enough to enjoy.

Overall, this thermal coffee maker isn’t anything amazing, but it is about as good as other thermal coffee makers, which means it is good enough to earn a passing grade. It is priced competitively, too, so it’s worth considering if you choose to go thermal.

product_metadata.title: Frigidaire Professional Stainless 10-Cup Thermal Carafe Coffee Maker
features: Thermal stainless-steel carafe keeps coffee hot
Coffee strength selector from regular to strong
Water filtration system ensures better tasting coffee
24 hr programmable—choose brew time of up to 24 hrs in advance
PowerPlus Brewing System distributes hot water evenly over coffee grounds for optimal flavor
description: Keep your coffee hot and fresh-tasting longer thanks to the stylish stainless-steel 10-Cup Frigidaire Professional Thermal Coffee Maker. The durable thermal carafe provides for ideal temperature, while the Coffee Strength Selector and PowerPlus brewing system ensures your decadent brew is just right.
24-hr Programmable Start Option Thermal Stainless-Steel Carafe
The durable, insulated carafe keeps coffee hot and fresh-tasting.

The coffee strength selector takes the guesswork out of a perfect cup of java – no more guessing with measuring cups – Frigidaire Professional built this Coffee Maker to fit your taste buds. Choose from settings that range from regular to strong to get your coffee just right, every time.

The Frigidaire Professional Coffee Maker has a built-in water filtration system that filters the water for better tasting coffee. The replaceable charcoal water filter assures you of fresh-tasting coffee.

True coffee lovers know that precisely-heated water is the key to a great cup of coffee. To ensure maximum flavor, the unique Frigidaire Professional PowerPlus Brewing System evenly distributes hot water over ground coffee beans so that the flavor has time to build and develop, inviting you to that first, perfect sip.
Clearly see what’s brewing with this large, easy-to-read LCD display.
